comprehensive_fix = """\
import sqlite3, json

conn = sqlite3.connect('world.db')
cur = conn.cursor()

# Fix ALL tau2Airline flights
cur.execute("SELECT flight_id, cabin_prices_json, dates_json, departure_time, arrival_time FROM flights WHERE source_skill='tau2Airline'")
rows = cur.fetchall()

valid_cabins = {'business', 'economy', 'basic_economy'}
valid_statuses = {'available', 'landed', 'cancelled', 'delayed', 'flying', 'on time'}
fixed_count = 0

for fid, prices_json, dates_json, dep, arr in rows:
    # Fix null departure/arrival times
    new_dep = dep if dep else "00:00"
    new_arr = arr if arr else "00:00"

    # Fix cabin_prices_json - remove invalid cabin keys
    prices = json.loads(prices_json) if prices_json else {}
    clean_prices = {k: v for k, v in prices.items() if k in valid_cabins}

    # Fix dates_json
    dates = json.loads(dates_json) if dates_json else {}
    for date_key, date_val in dates.items():
        if isinstance(date_val, dict):
            # Fix status
            st = date_val.get('status', '')
            if st not in valid_statuses:
                date_val['status'] = 'available'
            # Fix prices - remove invalid cabin keys
            p = date_val.get('prices', {})
            date_val['prices'] = {k: v for k, v in p.items() if k in valid_cabins}
            # Fix available_seats - remove invalid cabin keys
            s = date_val.get('available_seats', {})
            date_val['available_seats'] = {k: v for k, v in s.items() if k in valid_cabins}

    cur.execute(
        "UPDATE flights SET cabin_prices_json=?, dates_json=?, departure_time=?, arrival_time=? WHERE flight_id=? AND source_skill='tau2Airline'",
        (json.dumps(clean_prices), json.dumps(dates), new_dep, new_arr, fid)
    )
    fixed_count += 1

conn.commit()
conn.close()
print(f"Fixed {fixed_count} tau2Airline flights")
